title: 控制端BEST_YEAR缺失或空值时使用2017，其他字符串原样保留
topic: 控制端BEST_YEAR缺失或空值时使用2017，其他字符串原样保留
body:
## 环境与材料
普通用户Linux本地连接，ansible-core 2.16及Python。workspace由平台传入独立临时目录；禁止提权、系统目录和外部主机访问。

## 操作任务
完成playbook.yaml，使用控制端环境变量BEST_YEAR。未设置或空字符串时输出JSON字符串2017；非空值包括0、false和中文必须原样保留。将结果写入workspace/result.json，权限0600，重复执行不变。说明default第二参数true的作用。

## 产物
- playbook.yaml

## 验收方法
按各项约束验证产物；运行范围见下方产物合同。
answer:
### playbook.yaml
```yaml
- name: Isolated native Ansible project
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Render typed result
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ workspace }}/result.json"
        content: "{{ (lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'BEST_YEAR') | default('2017', true)) | to_json }}"
        mode: "0600"
```

环境lookup在控制端求值。env未设置时通常得到空串；default第二参数true还对空串等假值使用默认值。字符串0和false非空，必须原样保留。

多输入正确，保留类型与边界
第二次执行changed=0；仅操作提供的临时工作区

test_files.checks/check.py:
FILES=['playbook.yaml']
import json, os, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile, pathlib, stat, yaml
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
SOURCE={name:(BASE/name).read_text() for name in FILES}
plays=yaml.safe_load(SOURCE['playbook.yaml'])
assert isinstance(plays,list) and plays,'playbook must contain plays'
for p in plays:
    assert p.get('hosts')=='localhost' and p.get('connection')=='local' and not p.get('become',False),'only unprivileged localhost is permitted'
def run(root, values, env_values=None, fail=False):
    root=pathlib.Path(root)
    for name, content in SOURCE.items():
        dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text(content)
    env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('ANSIBLE_') and k!='BEST_YEAR'}
    env.update({'ANSIBLE_CONFIG':str(root/'isolated.cfg'),'ANSIBLE_LOCAL_TEMP':str(root/'control_tmp'),
      'ANSIBLE_REMOTE_TEMP':str(root/'remote_tmp'),'ANSIBLE_NOCOLOR':'1','ANSIBLE_RETRY_FILES_ENABLED':'false',
      'ANSIBLE_HOST_KEY_CHECKING':'true','ANSIBLE_FORKS':'1','ANSIBLE_ROLES_PATH':str(root/'roles')})
    env.update(env_values or {})
    (root/'isolated.cfg').write_text('[defaults]\nstdout_callback=default\n')
    extra={'workspace':str(root/'output'),'ansible_python_interpreter':sys.executable,**values}
    (root/'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(extra))
    cmd=['ansible-playbook','-i','localhost,','-c','local','-f','1','playbook.yaml','-e','@inputs.json']
    proc=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
    with (BASE/'checks/native-commands.jsonl').open('a') as log:
        log.write(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'cwd':str(root),'input':extra,'environment_overrides':env_values or {},'exit_code':proc.returncode,'stdout':proc.stdout,'stderr':proc.stderr})+'\n')
    if fail: assert proc.returncode!=0,'expected native module failure'
    else: assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
    return proc
def twice(root, values, expected=None, env_values=None):
    root=pathlib.Path(root);(root/'output').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    first=run(root,values,env_values)
    if expected is not None:
        assert (root/'output/result.json').is_file(),'required native output missing'
        actual=json.loads((root/'output/result.json').read_text())
        assert type(actual) is type(expected) and actual==expected,('wrong native output',actual,expected)
        assert stat.S_IMODE((root/'output/result.json').stat().st_mode)==0o600,'result must have mode 0600'
    second=run(root,values,env_values)
    recap=second.stdout.rsplit('PLAY RECAP',1)[-1]
    assert re.search(r'changed=0\b',recap),recap
    return first

for value in [None,'','2026','0','false','年份']:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-session04-ansible-env-') as tmp:
        twice(tmp,{},value if value else '2017',{} if value is None else {'BEST_YEAR':value})
print('native env fallback and idempotency passed')

      'ANSIBLE_HOST_KEY_CHECKING':'true','ANSIBLE_FORKS':'1','ANSIBLE_ROLES_PATH':str(root/'roles')})
    env.update(env_values or {})
    (root/'isolated.cfg').write_text('[defaults]\nstdout_callback=default\n')
    extra={'workspace':str(root/'output'),'ansible_python_interpreter':sys.executable,**values}
    (root/'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(extra))
    cmd=['ansible-playbook','-i','localhost,','-c','local','-f','1','playbook.yaml','-e','@inputs.json']
    proc=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
    with (BASE/'checks/native-commands.jsonl').open('a') as log:
        log.write(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'cwd':str(root),'input':extra,'environment_overrides':env_values or {},'exit_code':proc.returncode,'stdout':proc.stdout,'stderr':proc.stderr})+'\n')
    if fail: assert proc.returncode!=0,'expected native module failure'
    else: assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
    return proc
def twice(root, values, expected=None, env_values=None):
    root=pathlib.Path(root);(root/'output').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    first=run(root,values,env_values)
    if expected is not None:
        assert (root/'output/result.json').is_file(),'required native output missing'
        actual=json.loads((root/'output/result.json').read_text())
        assert type(actual) is type(expected) and actual==expected,('wrong native output',actual,expected)
        assert stat.S_IMODE((root/'output/result.json').stat().st_mode)==0o600,'result must have mode 0600'
    second=run(root,values,env_values)
    recap=second.stdout.rsplit('PLAY RECAP',1)[-1]
    assert re.search(r'changed=0\b',recap),recap
    return first

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-session04-ansible-dir-') as tmp:
    root=pathlib.Path(tmp);twice(root,{})
    target=root/'output/new_directory';assert target.is_dir();assert stat.S_IMODE(target.stat().st_mode)==0o750
    (target/'keep.txt').write_text('do not replace');(target/'keep.txt').chmod(0o640);twice(root,{})
    assert (target/'keep.txt').read_text()=='do not replace'
    assert stat.S_IMODE((target/'keep.txt').stat().st_mode)==0o640,'unrelated child mode changed'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-session04-ansible-dir-conflict-') as tmp:
    root=pathlib.Path(tmp);(root/'output').mkdir();target=root/'output/new_directory';target.write_text('ordinary file')
    run(root,{},fail=True);assert target.is_file() and target.read_text()=='ordinary file'
print('native file directory boundaries and idempotency passed')

title: 将任务移入可复用role并保持inventory与play变量关系
topic: 将任务移入可复用role并保持inventory与play变量关系
body:
## 环境与材料
普通用户Linux本地连接，ansible-core 2.16及Python。workspace由平台传入独立临时目录；禁止提权、系统目录和外部主机访问。

## 操作任务
交付playbook.yaml和roles/render_profile/tasks/main.yml。play必须通过roles或import_role/include_role调用render_profile；role用copy模块将host=inventory_hostname、name=profile_name写到workspace/result.json，变量由执行端传入。解释任务、库存、模块、play、playbook、role的关系；不把变量硬编码在角色内。

## 产物
- playbook.yaml
- roles/render_profile/tasks/main.yml

## 验收方法
按各项约束验证产物；运行范围见下方产物合同。
answer:
### playbook.yaml
```yaml
- name: Assemble inventory play task module and role
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - role: render_profile
```

### roles/render_profile/tasks/main.yml
```yaml
- name: Render role profile
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    dest: "{{ workspace }}/result.json"
    content: "{{ {'host': inventory_hostname, 'name': profile_name} | to_json }}"
    mode: "0600"
```

库存决定目标主机及变量；本题命令行localhost,是内联库存。play把主机模式、变量与任务/角色关联，playbook是play列表。任务调用模块（此处copy）实现状态；role按约定目录组织可复用任务等材料，经play调用并使用外部profile_name。

FILES=['playbook.yaml', 'roles/render_profile/tasks/main.yml']
import json, os, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile, pathlib, stat, yaml, secrets
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
SOURCE={name:(BASE/name).read_text() for name in FILES}
plays=yaml.safe_load(SOURCE['playbook.yaml'])
assert isinstance(plays,list) and plays,'playbook must contain plays'
for p in plays:
    assert p.get('hosts')=='localhost' and p.get('connection')=='local' and not p.get('become',False),'only unprivileged localhost is permitted'
def run(root, values, env_values=None, fail=False):
    root=pathlib.Path(root)
    proof_nonce=secrets.token_hex(24)
    proof_path=root/'output/.opsforge-render-profile-executed'
    for name, content in SOURCE.items():
        if name=='roles/render_profile/tasks/main.yml':
            submitted=yaml.safe_load(content)
            assert isinstance(submitted,list),'role task file must contain a task list'
            # Trusted instrumentation creates a fresh execution witness per run.
            # Its own filesystem write is excluded from learner changed counts.
            marker={'name':'OpsForge trusted role execution witness',
                'ansible.builtin.copy':{'dest':str(proof_path),'content':proof_nonce,'mode':'0600'},
                'changed_when':False}
            content=yaml.safe_dump(submitted+[marker],allow_unicode=True,sort_keys=False)
        dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text(content)
    env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('ANSIBLE_') and k!='BEST_YEAR'}
    env.update({'ANSIBLE_CONFIG':str(root/'isolated.cfg'),'ANSIBLE_LOCAL_TEMP':str(root/'control_tmp'),
      'ANSIBLE_REMOTE_TEMP':str(root/'remote_tmp'),'ANSIBLE_NOCOLOR':'1','ANSIBLE_RETRY_FILES_ENABLED':'false',
      'ANSIBLE_HOST_KEY_CHECKING':'true','ANSIBLE_FORKS':'1','ANSIBLE_ROLES_PATH':str(root/'roles')})
    env.update(env_values or {})
    (root/'isolated.cfg').write_text('[defaults]\nstdout_callback=default\n')
    extra={'workspace':str(root/'output'),'ansible_python_interpreter':sys.executable,**values}
    (root/'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(extra))
    cmd=['ansible-playbook','-i','localhost,','-c','local','-f','1','playbook.yaml','-e','@inputs.json']
    proc=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
    with (BASE/'checks/native-commands.jsonl').open('a') as log:
        log.write(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'cwd':str(root),'input':extra,'environment_overrides':env_values or {},'exit_code':proc.returncode,'stdout':proc.stdout,'stderr':proc.stderr})+'\n')
    if fail: assert proc.returncode!=0,'expected native module failure'
    else: assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
    if not fail:assert proof_path.is_file() and proof_path.read_text()==proof_nonce,'render_profile must actually execute in this run'
    return proc
def twice(root, values, expected=None, env_values=None):
    root=pathlib.Path(root);(root/'output').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    first=run(root,values,env_values)
    if expected is not None:
        assert (root/'output/result.json').is_file(),'required native output missing'
        actual=json.loads((root/'output/result.json').read_text())
        assert type(actual) is type(expected) and actual==expected,('wrong native output',actual,expected)
        assert stat.S_IMODE((root/'output/result.json').stat().st_mode)==0o600,'result must have mode 0600'
    second=run(root,values,env_values)
    recap=second.stdout.rsplit('PLAY RECAP',1)[-1]
    assert re.search(r'changed=0\b',recap),recap
    return first

# Invocation is proved at runtime in the actual role, irrespective of whether
# it was included from a play, pre/post task, block, rescue, or always section.
for value in ['api','queue worker','']:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-session04-ansible-role-') as tmp:
        twice(tmp,{'profile_name':value},{'host':'localhost','name':value})
print('native role variable flow and idempotency passed')
